top: Hundreds of people showed up in Chicago to push The Bean exactly 7 inches to the left, after a viral invite claimed a man was trapped inside. It didn't move an inch.
comment: Hundreds of strangers teaming up to free a man who doesn't exist is peak humanity 😂
